categories.name: ETF
categories.content: Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) is product that holds a basket of assets such as stocks, bonds, commodities, or crypto.

categories.name: Farming Games
categories.content: Farming game allows players to simulate farming life, focusing on activities such as planting and harvesting crops, raising livestock, and managing resources.

categories.name: IDR Stablecoin
categories.content: A IDR stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Indonesian rupiah.

categories.name: Zodiac-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins related to zodiac signs.

categories.name: Zora Creator
categories.content: Zora Creator Coins are profile-level tokens on the Zora platform, a blockchain-based social network focused on the creator economy. Each Zora account has its own unique Creator Coin, represented by the user's username as the ticker symbol (e.g., $username).

categories.name: Emoji-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins related to emoji.

categories.name: Market-Making Solution
categories.content: A Market-Making Solution refers to a service that enhances liquidity in markets by consistently offering buy and sell orders.

categories.name: Pools.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: Pools.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via pools.fun

categories.name: Animal Racing
categories.content: Animal racing tokens are digital tokens used in virtual animal racing games.

categories.name: daos.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: daos.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens that have active hedge funds on daos.fun.

categories.name: Camelot Launchpad
categories.content: Camelot Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Liquid Staking Tokens
categories.content: Liquid staking token is a tokenized representation of staked tokens that can be traded or used in various DeFi applications.

categories.name: Crypto-Backed Tokens
categories.content: Crypto-backed tokens are digital assets backed or collateralized by other cryptocurrencies. Stablecoins are excluded from this category and are classified separately under the Crypto-Backed Stablecoin category.

categories.name: Binance Megadrop
categories.content: Binance Megadrop is an airdrop program by Binance. It allows users to earn rewards by subscribing to BNB to Locked Products and completing tasks within their Binance Web3 Wallet.

categories.name: Virtual Reality
categories.content: Virtual reality (VR) uses computer-generated environments to create a simulated experience for users.

categories.name: Adventure Games
categories.content: Adventure game is a video game genre where players embark on a journey in a narrative-driven world, solving puzzles, interacting with characters, and making decisions that can influence the outcome of the story.

categories.name: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities
categories.content: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities are RWAs that digitalize sovereign debt instruments and international money market funds outside of the United States such as German Bunds, UK Gilts, and sovereign-backed cash equivalents, to provide diversified international yield and institutional collateral on-chain.

categories.name: Etherfuse Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized sovereign debt (Stablebonds) issued by Etherfuse in compliance of CNBV regulation.

categories.name: Retail
categories.content: Retail involves the sale of goods and services to consumers for their personal use, rather than for resale on blockchain.

categories.name: Insurance
categories.content: Decentralized insurance provides the infrastructure for members to buy cover, underwrite risk, assess claims, and build risk management businesses.
